The move asserts federal preemption over state gambling regulators, signaling the CFTC intends to shield CFTC-registered exchanges from state-level challenges as prediction markets expand into sports and election contracts.

title: eToro agrees to buy TradeZero for up to $231 million as equities drive Q2 growth
blurb: eToro agreed to acquire brokerage TradeZero for up to $231 million, expanding its US equities footprint as stock trading fuels its growth. Net contribution rose 9% year-over-year to $229 million in Q2, driven mainly by stronger equities trading, underscoring eToro's push to diversify beyond crypto into commission-based stock and options flow.

title: Coinbase picks Abu Dhabi for its global tokenized asset push
blurb: Coinbase secured a Financial Services Permission from Abu Dhabi Global Market's FSRA to arrange investment deals and custody tokenized securities, establishing its international tokenization hub in the emirate. The license lets Coinbase issue digital securities backed by underlying shares outside the U.S., positioning ADGM as its regulatory base for bringing traditional equities onchain as banks and asset managers move funds, bonds, and stocks to blockchain rails.

title: MoneyGram Brings Cash-To-Crypto Ramps To Solana
blurb: MoneyGram extended MoneyGram Ramps, its cash-to-crypto on- and off-ramp API, natively to Solana, removing the prior requirement to bridge USDC to Stellar before routing users into its retail cash network. Going native on a chain holding $15.73B in stablecoins gives developers direct access to cash deposits in 25+ countries and withdrawals across 170+, backed by nearly 500,000 retail locations, with self-custody app Rift as the first integration.

title: New York City Probes Kalshi and Polymarket Over Social Harms
blurb: The New York City Council opened a probe into the advertising practices of Kalshi, Polymarket, and two other prediction-market platforms, examining potential social harms from how the contracts are marketed. The inquiry adds a municipal front to the mounting legal and regulatory pressure on prediction markets, which already face CFTC scrutiny and state-level challenges over whether their event contracts amount to gambling.

title: India’s central bank wants AI to approve loans that humans would reject
blurb: The Reserve Bank of India proposed guidelines pushing lenders to deploy AI underwriting models that extend credit to thin-file borrowers whom traditional scorecards reject, part of a financial-inclusion push targeting India's large unbanked population. The move puts the RBI in the unusual position of encouraging looser algorithmic lending, raising questions about fair-lending oversight and default exposure as banks adopt models that override human rejection decisions.

title: Mapping the AI economy
blurb: Stripe published an analysis of its transaction data across thousands of AI companies, finding that the 100 largest by revenue reach 120 markets on average by their third year and draw 48% of revenue from outside their home markets. Beyond high-GDP hubs, India, Mexico, Poland, and the UAE showed outsized AI spend relative to overall Stripe volume, marking them as expansion targets where localized payment methods and pricing convert demand to revenue.

title: CFTC orders Kalshi to continue offering prediction markets in New York after state lawsuit
blurb: The CFTC invoked its emergency authority to order Kalshi to keep running sports-related prediction markets in New York, overriding the state's lawsuit that sought to shut the platform down as unlicensed gambling. The move escalates a jurisdictional fight over whether prediction markets are federally regulated swaps or state-regulated gaming, with CFTC Chairman Mike Selig arguing that interstate event contracts fall outside New York's gaming laws.

title: Stablecoin Card Issuer Rain Buys Merchant Wallet Startup Ansa
blurb: Rain acquired Ansa, a startup whose white-label APIs and SDKs let merchants run their own branded prepaid wallets, with founder Sophia Goldberg joining as head of payments. Rain plans to pair Ansa's stored fiat balances with its Visa and Mastercard issuing so a prefunded balance can spend outside the merchant that loaded it, consolidating wallets, rewards, and stablecoins onto one platform.

title: Brazil's largest lender Itaú is stepping deeper into the tokenization
blurb: Itaú Unibanco, Latin America's largest lender with over $562B in assets, partnered with infrastructure provider OpenAssets to pilot tokenized fixed-income securities and investment funds under an ANBIMA-run regulated test. The move adds a major bank to Brazil's push to issue, trade, and settle bonds and funds on distributed ledgers, following tokenization efforts from VERT Capital and Mercado Bitcoin.

title: eToro to Buy US Brokerage TradeZero for Up to $231M as Crypto Revenue Shrinks
blurb: eToro agreed to acquire US brokerage TradeZero for up to $231M in cash plus 2.5 million Class A shares, adding a regulated US broker-dealer and short-locator tooling as its crypto revenue contracts. Cryptoasset revenue fell to $1.35B in Q2 from $1.91B a year earlier, pushing eToro toward equities, where net trading income rose to $141.6M and funded accounts grew 18% to 4.28 million.

title: Kalshi brings in former U.S. solicitor general as Washington state gambling case escalates
blurb: Kalshi hired former U.S. Acting Solicitor General Neal Katyal to lead its Washington state appeal, escalating a fight over whether CFTC oversight of prediction markets preempts state gambling law after a King County judge granted an injunction against the platform on July 20. Judge McHale has yet to rule on Kalshi's stay motion, so the contracts remain live in Washington nearly three weeks on, with a decision expected within days.

title: Robinhood's Head of Product Reveals How Robinhood Chain Hit 200M Transactions in 30 Days
blurb: Robinhood Chain processed 200M transactions in its first 30 days, with Head of Product Seong Lee detailing the launch in a Defiant interview covering permissionless stock tokens that stay redeemable even if Robinhood shuts down and a DeFi lending product offering insured yield. The volume signals Robinhood's push to move tokenized equities and real-world assets onto its own chain rather than rely on third-party rails.

title: ‘Clear scale up path’: Bernstein sees 80% upside for Riot after reported $9.1 billion Anthropic deal
blurb: Bernstein raised its price target for Riot Platforms to $35 from $30, implying roughly 80% upside, after the bitcoin miner signed a $9.1B, 20-year colocation lease for 191 IT megawatts at its Rockdale, Texas campus with a frontier AI lab reported to be Anthropic. The firm now models AI colocation as 84% of Riot's target enterprise value, versus 11% for bitcoin mining, at roughly $457M in annual recurring revenue.

title: Barça Mobile Plans Stellar Wallet With Wirex and Crossmint
blurb: Barça Mobile, FC Barcelona's official MVNO operated by New Era Visionary Group, is building an in-app digital wallet using infrastructure from Wirex, Crossmint, and the Stellar Development Foundation, with Stellar as the blockchain layer and Wirex handling payment and card rails. The move extends the club's travel-eSIM app into payments, loyalty, and rewards, embedding wallet functionality into an existing consumer telecom product rather than launching a standalone fintech.

title: EToro reports second quarter crypto loss even as total profit beats estimates
blurb: EToro swung to a $7.2 million crypto-trading loss in Q2 2026, down from a $37.7 million profit a year earlier, as cryptoasset revenue fell 29% to $1.35 billion and July crypto trades dropped 73% year over year. Overall net income still beat estimates at $0.68 adjusted EPS, but shares fell about 11% as the company leaned into onchain products and agreed to buy U.S. brokerage TradeZero for up to $231 million.

title: FlightAware sues Kalshi over flight cancellation prediction markets
blurb: FlightAware sued Kalshi in federal court, alleging the prediction market used FlightAware's flight data and branding without authorization to settle bets on U.S. flight cancellations. The suit escalates the legal exposure around Kalshi's event contracts, arguing the cancellation markets create a manipulation and safety risk on top of the underlying data-licensing dispute.

title: Why JPMorgan is investing big in the 2028 LA Olympics
blurb: JPMorgan signed on as the Olympics' first global banking partner, a nine-figure deal covering the 2028 LA Games and 2030 French Alps Games at a reported $200M-plus per cycle. The bank paired the sponsorship with a 30% increase in Southern California business bankers, targeting its 5M consumer and 589,000 small-business clients in LA to convert brand spend into account acquisition.

title: DORA Is No Longer a Deadline
blurb: The European Supervisory Authorities published their first DORA incident overview on June 3, 2026, ending the informal supervisory tolerance of 2025 as national authorities begin auto-cross-checking Register of Information submissions and issuing initial compulsion payments. Enforcement is arriving unevenly, with penalty ceilings ranging from Italy's €20M or 10% of turnover down to the Czech Republic's €2M, even as Poland and Bulgaria have yet to fully transpose DORA into national law.

title: Australian watchdog suspends Cryptolink, forcing 96 ATMs offline
blurb: AUSTRAC suspended crypto ATM operator Cryptolink for three months effective Aug. 9, pulling 96 machines offline after the firm missed required threshold transaction reports and ignored an information request. The regulator, which capped cash-to-crypto transactions at A$5,000 in June, signaled it will keep pursuing other ATM operators where it finds weak anti-money-laundering controls.

title: Stockholm’s Quartr lands €15.6 million to expand its AI-ready public company IR data coverage
blurb: Quartr raised €15.6M led by Altos Ventures, with SEB joining, to expand its structured IR data covering 15,000+ companies across 65 markets.

title: HSBC Asset Management invests in London-founded Model ML
blurb: HSBC Asset Management took an equity stake in Model ML, the London-founded AI automation startup for financial services, pushing its total raised past $100M after a $75M Series A last November. The vertical-AI vendor, which counts Deloitte and PwC as clients and routes each task to the best-suited model, will use the funding to win banking and asset-manager accounts.

title: HSBC Asset Management backs AI finance group Model ML
blurb: HSBC Asset Management invested in Model ML, a 2023-founded startup building a model-agnostic orchestration engine that automates financial research, due diligence, and document generation while enforcing enterprise governance and auditability. The deal, made through HSBC's flagship VC strategy within its $81B alternatives platform on undisclosed terms, signals institutional conviction that vertical AI software, not any single model, is the differentiator for automating financial-services workflows.

title: Danish Entravel Group raises €6.5 million to secure larger supplier credit facilities
blurb: Entravel Group raised €6.5M, co-led by Ethereal Ventures and Finality Capital, to expand supplier credit facilities and stablecoin settlement.
